items.html: And understand well everything that we have explained, and it is in this manner: for the right line of this Partzuf, which is Chesed, Chokhma, Netzach, is clothed in the three articles (Perkim) of the Netzach of this Tevunah; and the left line, which is Gevura, Bina, Hod, is clothed in the three articles of the Hod of Tevunah; and the middle line, which is Daat, Tifferet, Yesod, is clothed in the two articles of the Yesod of Tevunah, which are only two articles: Yesod and its corona (Atara). And there the entire middle line of the Partzuf of the Tzelem stands closed.
